results.title: Wolpie of the Woods
results.overview: Driven by hunger through a forest of strange cryptids, a determined Wolpertinger discovers that it's a trap to only look out for himself because it keeps the creatures predictable. Seen from a new perspective, he learns that connection, not isolation, offers him the best chance of survival.

results.title: Journey There
results.overview: Chun-hee is left alone in the world after the sudden death of her husband. Faced with her own illness, she puts her life in order, but she intends to keep the appointment she made with her husband for an assisted suicide.

results.title: 9 Moons
results.overview: Ángel is a personal trainer who, after taking a year off, has just landed a job at the most prestigious gym in the city, and life finally seems to be back on track. But everything changes when he begins to feel unwell, goes to the hospital, and receives shocking news: he’s pregnant. A trans man on the verge of completing his transition, Ángel is now confronted with a life-altering decision—one that will challenge his identity, his aspirations, and his very understanding of masculinity.

results.title: In My Mother's Mirror
results.overview: When successful archaeologist Ursula Scheuer makes a sensational discovery of a body during a bog excavation, her demented mother suddenly dies. Unexpectedly, a childhood trauma breaks out for Ursula. The appearance of her new assistant Mel is also puzzling: she seems to know Ursula’s past very well. Ursula is increasingly drawn into a mysterious web of fantasies and deceptions and must finally free herself from it.

results.title: Eine florentinische Tragödie / Herzog Blaubarts Burg - Wiener Staatsoper
results.original_title: Eine florentinische Tragödie / Herzog Blaubarts Burg - Wiener Staatsoper
results.overview: The two short operas Eine Florentinische Tragödie and Herzog Blaubarts Burg are linked by a central theme: the progressive recognition of the only seemingly familiar counterpart.  In Zemlinsky's Eine Florentinische Tragödie, the murder of Bianca's lover by her jealous husband Simone leads to a dialog between the two spouses that surprisingly signals a new beginning of love. In Bartók's one-act opera, however, Judith's journey to the inner depths of her beloved Duke Bluebeard - symbolized by the opening of seven mysterious doors - ends in darkness and loneliness.

results.title: How to Remember
results.overview: In 2020s Berlin, 95-year-old Leonid Berezin, along with other surviving eyewitnesses, is fighting to keep alive the memory of a nearly forgotten Nazi war crime: at the age of twelve, he survived the Siege of Leningrad—the systematic starvation of what is now Saint Petersburg.

results.title: Even If Hell Came
results.overview: Northern Italy, Winter 1944. After a brutal enemy sweep leaves him isolated in a remote mountain refuge, a young partisan is forced into a relentless fight against war, nature and his own fears, where survival becomes the ultimate act of resistance.

results.title: Wayward
results.overview: The story of the women who changed snowboarding by refusing to follow the status quo. spanning 4 decades of firsthand accounts from pioneering athletes who fought for visibility, opportunity, and respect in a male-dominated sport.

results.title: Stardom Nighter in Korakuen 2026 Mar.2
results.overview: Stardom Nighter in Korakuen 2026 Mar.2 was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on March 31, 2026 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: I Sassi
results.overview: Alessandra and Elisa are fifteen, bound by an intense connection that shifts between closeness, desire, and subtle jealousy. Elisa is about to move abroad, and the looming distance charges every gesture with new weight. They tease, provoke, and cling to each other, as if holding on and pushing away were the same thing. What they can’t express surfaces in silences, in glances, in the fragile balance between them. Over the course of a long afternoon, following the path of a river, they drift along the edges of their world: boys who bully, men who blur boundaries, glimpses of an adult world they observe without fully understanding. In that uncertain space - shaped by fear, confusion, and desire - something cracks. An extreme act begins to take shape, driven by something deep, unspoken, and unresolved.

results.title: Paatki
results.overview: A man certain of his guilt faces a world certain of his innocence, and the truth shatters them both.

results.title: Byeeee
results.overview: After getting busted for defrauding her investors, tech girlboss entrepreneur Andy is heading to her family’s abandoned lakeside cottage for one last weekend before she kills herself.

results.title: Трудные папы
results.overview: Katya is smart, modest and diligent, but most importantly, she is very convenient for those around her, which they take advantage of. After the death of her overprotective mother, Katya inherits her mother's late lover Andrey Nikolaevich, who has nowhere else to live, along with the house. However, this is not our heroine's main problem. The secrets that her mother hid from Katya during her life, the mortgage debt, because of which she could lose her home, and the mysterious man to whom her mother has been sending large sums of money for many years - Katya will have to figure all this out, and for the first time in her life - on her own.

results.title: The Mad Dog of Europe
results.overview: A documentary exploring the 1933 screenplay of the same name by Citizen Kane co-writer Herman Mankiewicz, which warned of Adolf Hitler's rise to power, but was rejected by Hollywood studios at the time.

results.title: Death on the Brandywine
results.overview: U.S. Senator Daniel Riley is found dead at his grand estate. While the police quickly rule his death a suicide, his daughter Jackie refuses to believe it. Suspecting murder, she asks her life partner, forensic psychologist and professor Millie Park, to investigate the case in secret. As Jackie and Millie dig into the family's past, they uncover a web of dark political secrets, bitter sibling rivalries, and dangerous ambitions. Set against the high-stakes backdrop of a tight election, the couple faces growing danger as they get closer to the truth. They must untangle the lies of a powerful family to expose the real killer before it is too late.

results.title: TS-CAM
results.overview: The commission of a triptych sends a guilty painter into a downward spiral.

results.title: Termite
results.overview: Shaunak Sen’s follow-up to the Academy Award–nominated documentary All That Breathes is an evocative drama set in the vibrant neighbourhoods of Old Delhi, where the routined lives of two middle-aged termite exterminators are about to drastically change when one of them receives an unexpected marriage proposal.
